answer: Unrepeatable Challenge Orchard. Each identity must solve a fresh, randomly generated puzzle whose solution curve bottoms at a unique nadir; the answer is checked against a seed drawn from the prior block, so copying a neighbor's reply fails verification. Attackers pay one full solve per identity per epoch, and stale solutions cannot cross the dune between epochs. Successful solvers gain a garden slot that expires unless refreshed. The per-identity cost is a fresh sequential computation each round, not a one-time fee.
